### New in 1.3.0
- **Continue with Google**: first-time onboarding now features quick Google email sign-in, automatically setting up your reading profile, name, and personal handle.
- **Enhanced Profile**: displays your connected email directly on your profile alongside your reading stats and badges.
- **Streamlined Setup**: smoother first-run welcome flow with instant 1-tap autocomplete and sample library selection.

### Install / update
Download `shelfwise.apk` below and open it. It installs over older versions and keeps everything.
